name: B10-0131/2026 (PPE) – Targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the targeted expulsions of foreign journalists and foreign Christians in Türkiye under national security pretexts
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Türkiye to stop using "national security" labels to expel foreign Christians and foreign journalists. It says at least 132 foreign Christians have been expelled or banned from re-entering since 2019, and it asks Türkiye to review these security codes, lift unjustified entry bans, allow genuine court review, and not deport detained Iranian journalist Kaveh Taheri.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament asks Türkiye to review security codes and lift unjustified entry bans.
- It affects foreign Christians and foreign journalists in Türkiye, including detained journalist Kaveh Taheri.
- Next, the EU Commission and top diplomat should raise these concerns with Türkiye.
